description:
Search the FAR and the DFARS (48 CFR chapters 1 and 2, as codified in the eCFR): sections
    whose title or text has every word, or a section number (e.g. 52.219-14) straight to it.
    reg: FAR | DFARS to limit. Returns section numbers, titles and a snippet; read one with
    get_far_section. The codified text lags the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul's class deviations.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the section's title or text (e.g. "limitations on subcontracting"), or a section number (e.g. "52.219-14").
query.title: Query

reg.description: Limit to one regulation: FAR or DFARS; omit for both.
reg.title: Reg

name: search_far
title: Search the FAR and DFARS
